    GilpGroundStability:
      title: GILP Ground Stability
      description: |
        Postcode-level potential insurance risk from natural ground movement, from
        the BGS GeoSure Insurance and Lenders Product (GILP) Derived Postcode
        Database. Combines the six GeoSure hazards on (low-rise) buildings:
        shrink-swell, landslides, soluble rocks, running sand, compressible ground
        and collapsible deposits.

        Field names, types and score ranges mirror the GILP v8 Derived Postcode
        Database verbatim (lower-cased), per the BGS user guide (Open Report
        OR/26/013). Scores are unitless measures of expected impact, normalised by
        expert elicitation so they are comparable and summable across hazards;
        `total` is the sum of the six individual hazard scores.

        Hazards cover NATURAL ground movement only - no mining or contaminated
        land (compressible ground is the one layer that considers man-made ground,
        e.g. landfill). Values are generalised to postcode level; minimum
        meaningful resolution is the postcode.
      type: object
      required:
        - postcode
        - collapse
        - rsand
        - comp
        - sswell
        - solub
        - landslide
        - total
        - class
        - version
      properties:
        postcode:
          type: string
          maxLength: 8
          description: The individual postcode.
          example: BA1 0AA
        collapse:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 18
          description: |
            The individual hazard score value for collapsible deposits - rocks and
            soils that may collapse when a load is placed on them, especially when
            saturated.
          example: 0
        rsand:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 22
          description: |
            The individual hazard score value for running sand - loosely packed
            sandy layers that can become fluidised by water flowing through them,
            potentially removing support from overlying buildings.
          example: 6
        comp:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 148
          description: |
            The individual hazard score value for compressible ground - very soft
            materials like peat or some clays that may compress if loaded by
            overlying structures or if the groundwater level changes.
          example: 74
        sswell:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1000
          description: |
            The individual hazard score value for shrink-swell - swelling clays
            that change volume with moisture variation, particularly in the upper
            two metres of the ground.
          example: 252
        solub:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 73
          description: |
            The individual hazard score value for soluble rocks (dissolution) -
            soluble material dissolving to form underground cavities that reduce
            support to the ground above.
          example: 0
        landslide:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 787
          description: |
            The individual hazard score value for landslide - slope instability
            causing down-slope movement of materials such as a landslide or
            rockfall.
          example: 35
        total:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 2000
          description: The total combined score of all 6 hazards.
          example: 367
        class:
          type: string
          enum:
            - Low
            - Low-Medium
            - Medium
            - Medium-High
            - High
          description: |
            Classification of the insurance hazard potential, dividing `total`
            into 5 equal categories: Low (0-399), Low-Medium (400-799), Medium
            (800-1199), Medium-High (1200-1599), High (1600-2000).
          example: Low
        version:
          type: string
          maxLength: 50
          description: |
            Dataset name and version number, encoding the GeoSure version and the
            OS Code-Point Open version used in production.
          example: GILP_v8_2025.3
